title: Hybrid concurrency model for AI agent closeout operations
description: Established hybrid concurrency approach for Wheelwright closeout: file locking for critical operations (WAI-State.json, WAI-Lugs.jsonl), graceful serialization for others (teaching distribution, git operations). Includes deterministic session IDs, comprehensive duplicate detection with warn-continue behavior, and mandatory idempotency testing integration.
rationale: Solves fundamental concurrency and replay safety issues for AI agents performing closeout operations. Enables safe multi-agent collaboration while maintaining usability through warn-continue duplicate handling. Critical for canonical Wheelwright deployment across spoke fleets.

technical_details.duplicate_detection: Session summaries, signal teachings, state updates, git commits
technical_details.test_integration: 34 idempotency tests in shipit quality gates
